The '''Midnight Carp''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in [[The Mountain|the mountain lake]] and the [[Cindersap Forest]] pond during [[Fall]] and [[Winter]] late at night.  It can also be caught on many of the non-standard [[Farm Maps]]: Forest, Riverland, Wilderness, and the large pond on the Four Corners Map. It can also be caught during any season in [[Ginger Island]] North and West (freshwater). It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It can also randomly be found at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|150}} or in [[Garbage Can]]s during Fall or Winter.

Midnight Carp can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Fish Pond==
Midnight Carp can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing two quests. The primary output is violet Midnight Carp [[Roe]]. However, [[River Jelly]] is also possible starting at population 7.

==Tailoring==
Midnight Carp can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt157.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Fishing Vest]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a purple dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as an iridium dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*'''Item Delivery:''' One Midnight Carp may be randomly requested in [[Fall]] or [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|450}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Aquatic Overpopulation:''' [[Demetrius]] may request 10 Midnight Carp to be caught in [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] outside the [[Mayor's Manor]] for a reward of gold equivalent to selling the fish and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.
